title: Operon: Incremental Construction of Ragged Data via Named Dimensions
abstract: arXiv:2511.16080v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern data processing workflows frequently encounter ragged data: collections with variable-length elements that arise naturally in domains like natural language processing, scientific measurements, and autonomous AI agents. Existing workflow engines lack native support for tracking the shapes and dependencies inherent to ragged data, forcing users to manage complex indexing and dependency bookkeeping manually. We present Operon, a Rust-based workflow engine that addresses these challenges through a novel formalism of named dimensions with explicit dependency relations. Operon provides a domain-specific language where users declare pipelines with dimension annotations that are statically verified for correctness, while the runtime system dynamically schedules tasks as data shapes are incrementally discovered during execution. translated_title: Operon：通过命名维度增量构建不规则数据
translated_abstract: 现代数据处理工作流经常遇到不规则数据：即包含可变长度元素的集合，这类数据自然产生于自然语言处理、科学测量和自主AI智能体等领域。现有的工作流引擎缺乏对不规则数据固有的形状和依赖关系的原生支持，迫使用户手动管理复杂的索引和依赖记录。我们提出了Operon，一个基于Rust的工作流引擎，它通过一种新颖的命名维度形式化方法及显式依赖关系来解决这些挑战。Operon提供了一种领域特定语言，用户可以在其中声明带有维度标注的管道，这些标注会经过静态验证以确保正确性；同时运行时系统在执行过程中随着数据形状的逐步发现而动态调度任务。我们形式化了用于推理部分形状的数学基础，并证明了Operon的……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Operon是一个基于Rust的工作流引擎，通过命名维度与显式依赖关系的形式化方法，结合静态验证的领域特定语言和增量式的动态任务调度，实现了对不规则数据形状与依赖关系的原生追踪与管理。
en_tdlr: Operon is a Rust-based workflow engine that natively tracks the shapes and dependencies of ragged data through a novel formalism of named dimensions with explicit dependency relations, combining a statically verified domain-specific language with dynamic incremental task scheduling.
